purpose: Test whether the dates carrying Blue Book STARLIKE reports and public POSS-I candidate-rate structure align with other independently defined environmental or human-made event calendars, while controlling season, observation opportunity, sky footprint and multiple testing.

primary_cross_channel_test.exposure: exact calendar day with >=1 frozen Blue Book STARLIKE case
primary_cross_channel_test.outcome: POSS-I S0 candidate_count conditional on an actually observed Palomar night
primary_cross_channel_test.model: NB2 candidate_count ~ STARLIKE_day + month/year + sky footprint + exposure/WCS + lunar illumination + daily Ap + daily max Kp; offset log(tile_count)
primary_cross_channel_test.schedule_test: Separately test whether STARLIKE dates overlap Palomar observation opportunity more than year-month matched pseudo-dates.
primary_cross_channel_test.interpretation: A positive rate coefficient would indicate cross-channel same-day temporal association only; it would not establish the same physical object or global cause.

frozen_discovery_families.source: GFZ Kp_ap_Ap_SN_F107_since_1932 frozen source already bound in JPFM-2E
frozen_discovery_families.definition: f107_adj >= 90th percentile computed on all 2718 study-window calendar days before joining either outcome
isn >= 90th percentile on all 2718 study-window calendar days

frozen_discovery_families.source: IAU Meteor Data Center established-shower context
frozen_discovery_families.definition: Gregorian proxy peak +/-2 days for the frozen major annual set: Quadrantids Jan-03, Lyrids Apr-22, eta Aquariids May-06, Southern delta Aquariids Jul-30, Perseids Aug-12, Orionids Oct-21, Leonids Nov-17, Geminids Dec-14
frozen_discovery_families.limitation: Proxy calendar; historical solar-longitude reconstruction is a required sensitivity before any meteor attribution.

two_layer_execution.POSS_layer: For every family fit candidate rate only on observed nights; never insert unobserved nights as zero candidates.
two_layer_execution.BLUEBOOK_layer: For every family test STARLIKE case/day overlap on the 2718-day calendar with 50000 year-month blocked pseudo-event permutations when a binary event calendar exists.
two_layer_execution.cross_layer_gate: A family is a CROSS_LAYER_PATTERN_CANDIDATE only if its direction is concordant in both layers and survives the declared multiplicity rule; otherwise record SINGLE_LAYER or NULL.

multiple_testing.correction: Benjamini-Hochberg FDR across the six discovery families separately for each outcome layer
multiple_testing.D4_role: nested severity sensitivity; not counted as an independent discovery family

context_only_reason: These require a reasonably complete dated manifest before absence can be treated as a meaningful control. Individual famous dates may be displayed as context but may not enter v1 significance claims.
admission_rules: No new v1 event family after result inspection.
A sharp lag peak is stronger evidence of timing specificity than a broad seasonal association; all frozen lag profiles must be shown.
Any signal that disappears after observation-opportunity conditioning is classified as schedule structure, not candidate-rate structure.
Any meteor signal remains provisional until the Gregorian proxy is replaced by a solar-longitude reconstruction.
Any human/POSS same-day association does not establish identical objects because Blue Book locations and Palomar sky footprints differ.
No correlation may be promoted to nuclear, extraterrestrial or non-human causality.
